name: Kiriya Sumi
source:
[i]Female head of the Kiritani family[/i]

A strict lady who helps the sick head of the family manage the household.

She does not succumb to various external pressures and will do anything to uphold the Kiritani name. There are even indications that she sees her own daughters as tools for her benefit.

[Translated from [url=https://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HB/kiriya/main.html]Official Site[/url]]
